title: Plasmid Extraction (Plasmid Isolation)
author: NUS iGEM
materials: Use NanoDrop NanoDrop™ One/OneC Microvolume UV-Vis Spectrophotometer (UV-Vis Spectrophotometer, Thermo Scientific, ND-ONE-W) to measure the concentration (under "dsDNA" mode) and the purity of the plasmid.

Use NanoDrop NanoDrop™ One/OneC Microvolume UV-Vis Spectrophotometer (UV-Vis Spectrophotometer, Thermo Scientific, ND-ONE-W) to measure the concentration (under "dsDNA" mode) and the purity of the plasmid.

steps.title: Culture Cell Growth
steps.instruction: Incubate cells containing the plasmid of interest in a Falcon tube with 5 mL of LB media and 5 µL of the appropriate antibiotics overnight at 37 °C.

steps.title: Harvest Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Collect the cultured cells and isolate the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Remove the Falcon tube from the incubator.
Centrifuge the tube at 5000 rpm for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Discard the supernatant and retain the cell pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet using Buffer P1.

substeps.instruction: Add 250 µL of Buffer P1 (Qiagen Catalog #19051, with RNase A Qiagen Catalog #19101 added, stored at 4 °C) to the Falcon tube.
Resuspend the cell pellet.
Transfer the entire solution into an Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Lyse Cells
steps.instruction: Perform cell lysis using Buffer P2.

substeps.instruction: Add 250 µL of Buffer P2 (Qiagen Catalog #19052) to the Eppendorf tube.
Shake the tube to mix.

steps.title: Neutralize Solution
steps.instruction: Neutralize the lysate using Buffer N3.

substeps.instruction: Add 350 µL of Buffer N3 (Qiagen Catalog #19064) to the Eppendorf tube.
Shake the tube to mix until a cloudy solution is observed.
Centrifuge the tube at 13 rpm for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Bind Plasmid to Column
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a Mini Prep tube to bind the plasmid.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant into a Mini Prep tube and discard the cell debris.
Centrifuge at 13 rpm for 1 minute.

steps.title: Wash Column with PB Buffer
steps.instruction: Wash the column using PB buffer.

substeps.instruction: Discard the flow-through and place the Mini Prep tube back into the same tube.
Add 500 µL of PB buffer (Qiagen Catalog #19066) into the Mini Prep tube.
Centrifuge at 13 rpm for 1 minute.

steps.title: Wash Column with PE Buffer
steps.instruction: Wash the column using Buffer PE to remove residuals.

substeps.instruction: Discard the flow-through and place the Mini Prep tube back into the same tube.
Add 700 µL of Buffer PE (Qiagen Catalog #19065) into the Mini Prep tube.
Centrifuge at 13 rpm for 1 minute to remove Buffer PE residual.
Centrifuge at 13 rpm for 1 minute, ensuring the Eppendorf tube cap faces the direction of spinning to avoid breaking.

steps.title: Elute Plasmid
steps.instruction: Elute the isolated plasmid from the column.

substeps.instruction: Discard the flow-through and place the Mini Prep tube back into the same tube.
Transfer the Mini Prep column into a newly labelled Eppendorf tube.
Add 50 µL of DI water into the Eppendorf tube.
Discard the Mini Prep column; the remaining solution in the Eppendorf tube is the plasmid.

steps.title: Store Plasmid
steps.instruction: Store the isolated plasmid at room temperature.
